definitions.explanation: The act of casting a vote in an election, poll, or decision-making process. Can also refer to the vote itself.

examples.japanese: {選挙|せんきょ}で{投票|とうひょう}に{行|い}きましたか。
examples.english: Did you go to vote in the election?

examples.japanese: {投票|とうひょう}{率|りつ}が{低|ひく}いのが{問題|もんだい}だ。
examples.english: Low voter turnout is a problem.

examples.japanese: {投票|とうひょう}は18{歳|さい}からできる。

notes:
USAGE: {投票|とうひょう} is used for formal voting in elections, referendums, and official polls. For informal decisions or show-of-hands votes, {多数決|たすうけつ} (majority rule) is often used.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{投票|とうひょう}する (to vote)
・{投票|とうひょう}に{行|い}く (to go to vote)
・{投票|とうひょう}{用紙|ようし} (ballot paper)
・{投票|とうひょう}{所|じょ}/{投票|とうひょう}{場|じょう} (polling station)
・{投票|とうひょう}{日|び} (election day)
・{投票|とうひょう}{率|りつ} (voter turnout)

RELATED WORDS:
・{選挙|せんきょ} (election)
・{票|ひょう} (vote, ballot)
・{候補|こうほ} (candidate)
・{有権者|ゆうけんしゃ} (eligible voter)
・{棄権|きけん} (abstention)
